description_en: Queries the performance data of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询实例性能数据
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-instance-performance --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --key MySQL_NetworkTraffic --start-time 2012-06-08T15:00Z --end-time 2012-06-18T15:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstancePerformance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The performance metrics that you want to query. Separate multiple values with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 metrics. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26316.html.
If Key is set to MySQL_SpaceUsage or SQLServer_SpaceUsage, only monitoring data within the last day can be queried
parameters.help_zh:
想要查询的性能指标，多个值用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多传入30个。详细参数请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26316.html。
Key为MySQL_SpaceUsage或SQLServer_SpaceUsage时，仅支持查询1天内的监控数据
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC). The interval between the start time and end time must be greater than the monitoring frequency of your instance. Otherwise, an empty list may be returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 开始和结束时间间隔需要大于您实例的监控频率，否则可能返回空列表
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC). The interval between the start time and end time must be greater than the monitoring frequency of your instance. Otherwise, an empty list may be returned
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 开始和结束时间间隔需要大于您实例的监控频率，否则可能返回空列表
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the instance
parameters.name: node_id

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)

PerformanceKey.description_en: The list of instance performance metrics

items.description_en: The details of an instance performance metric

ValueFormat.description_en:
The format of the performance value.

If the performance value consists of multiple parameters, the parameters are separated by ampersands (&), such as com_delete&com_insert&com_insert_select&com_replace
ValueFormat.description_zh:
性能值的格式。

如果性能值由多个参数构成，以“&”分隔，例如com_delete&com_insert&com_insert_select&com_replace

PerformanceValue.description_en: The list of performance metric values

items.description_en:
The details of a performance metric value.

Array format: {value1, value2, ...}
items.description_zh:
性能参数值详情。

数组格式：{value1, value2, …}

Date.description_en: The date of the record. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
